actions.log_found: Update dialog detected — closing via X (not updating)
actions.note: Root-caused 2026-10-01 (bug-log-doctor, live repro on a cold MEmu-0 boot): the in-game 'A new version detected' Tips popup changed its footer from two buttons ('Google Play' / 'Start Game') to a single 'GO' button plus an X-close icon in the title bar (seen at App Ver 1.250.701(2658)). The old detection template btn_update_detected.png (a crop of the whole old two-button dialog) scored only ~0.64 against the current popup vs the 0.8 threshold, so detection silently failed every time and this task no-op'd — leaving the popup on screen to block verify_in_hq and every task behind it on nearly every cold start (seen in ~19/20 recent bot_*.log files as 'Action failed — recovering view' right after 'Bot started'). Fix: detect+tap the new X-close icon (btn_close_update_tips.png, cropped from a live repro frame; verified via vision.find_template at score ~0.97 on-popup vs ~0.55 on a plain loading screen — well separated from the 0.8 threshold). Deliberately closing via X rather than running the old Google-Play-update flow — we don't want the bot force-updating the app mid-run, which could change the UI the other templates are calibrated against.
